trans_title: 废弃建筑之谜 第六季
introduction: Some of the world's most amazing engineering projects now lie in ruins. How and why? These are the stories of the extraordinary people who originally designed them and of those whose ingenuity and brilliance is now giving many spectacular new life.1. World's Strangest Disaster Zones2. Swamp of Despair3. End Times on Lake Michigan4. Hell on Blood Island5. Florida Doomsday Castle6. The Killer in the Castle7. Towers of Blood8. The Thing on Hell Mountain9. Anarchy on Ireland's Alcatraz10. House of Horror11. Nightmare at Fort Paranoia
